title: It Is What It Is
overview: Back in the present, Takemichi is stunned to learn that he has become officer in Toman. Kisaki seizes an opportunity to dupe him, and Takemichi finds himself staring down the barrel of a gun.

title: Gotta Go
overview: Back in the past, Takemichi meets Hakkai and Yuzuha Shiba and forms a friendly bond. On the way to the Shiba's home, a chance meeting with Black Dragon turns violent.

title: Stand Alone
overview: Takemichi is beaten to a pulp by Taiju Shiba. In order to save Takemichi, Hakkai proposes a bargain to Taiju.

title: Family Bonds
overview: Disaster is avoided when Hakkai offers to join Black Dragon. However, Mitsuya will not allow Hakkai to leave Toman, and confronts Taiju.

title: Christmas Eve
overview: Kisaki and Hanma offer their help to Takemichi and Chifuyu in the rescue of Hakkai and destroying Black Dragon. Takemichi and Chifuyu come to a decision.

title: Whip Up Morale
overview: Propelled by each their own motives, the alliance members head to the church on Christmas night.

title: Sibling Rivalry
overview: Yuzuha's surprise attack on Taiju misses its mark. Takemichi realizes Yuzuha is the key to changing the future, so he gets back into the fight.

title: Strive Together
overview: Mitsuya arrives at the church, but is seriously injured in a surprise attack. Finding himself in another pinch, Takemichi gathers himself and makes a bold declaration regarding the future of Black Dragon. Though Taiju continues to beat him down, Takemichi keeps getting back up to face him again.

title: Dawning of a New Era
overview: After revealing his secret, Hakkai overcomes his fear of his brother and faces down Taiju with Takemichi. Just when defeat looks imminent, the familiar sound of a bike engine heralds Mikey's arrival at the church. However, something seems odd about him.

title: The Light of My Life
overview: After defeating Black Dragon, Takemichi finds himself being taken by Mikey to Hina's place, to face the girl he broke up with just the day before.

title: On My Way Home
overview: After declaring victory over Black Dragon at Tokyo Manji Gang's first meeting of the year, Mikey makes an unexpected announcement.

title: Last Order
overview: Certain that he has changed the future, Takemichi returns to the present. However, the timeline he returns to is the worst one yet.

title: When It Rains, It Pours
overview: Takemichi returns to the past to change the horrific new timeline. After meeting Chifuyu, Takemichi realizes what he must do.
